attacks.name: Anti-Matter Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After the attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Let Loose
steps: |!critical| |!wild| |*Energy Pulse|: After each attack is resolved, deal 1 |!damage| to each other enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character. Then this character loses 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Time‘s Up
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 3, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Anti-Matter Barrier
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character within |!range| 3 is defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may use this superpower. The defender may reroll any number of defense dice, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Hyper Cosmic Awareness
superPowers.body: Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least 1 |!failure|.

superPowers.name: Living Anti-Matter Reactor
superPowers.body: When attacking, defending, or dodging, this character adds |!failure| results to its total successes.
